property_summary: For any admissible deposit amount, one successful deposit into C's receive() increases depositsCount by exactly 1, but the mutant increments it by 2, so the rule 'after one deposit of any amount x, c.depositsCount() == 1' holds on P and fails on M.
change_summary: Change depositsCount++ to depositsCount += 2 so each deposit increments the counter by two.
